label: Specification id
description: Row number of the full grid of the universe (algebraic duplicates included), so ids are stable when the duplicates are left out. Ids are specific to a run's model and universe.

label: Counts
description: Outcome construct: number of nonprofits.

label: Resources
description: Outcome construct: nonprofit dollars (expenses or revenue).

label: Hospitals & universities in
description: Hospitals (NTEE E20-E24) and universities (B40-B43, B50) are included in the outcome.

label: Hospitals & universities out
description: Hospitals and universities are excluded from the outcome (the _nohu outcomes).

label: Filers
description: 501(c)(3) public charities filing a Form 990 or 990-EZ (above the real-dollar floor) per CBSA-year.

label: Filers excl. H&U
description: Filers, excluding hospitals and universities.

label: Filers, human services
description: Filers in human services (subsector extension; kitchen universe only).

label: Registered
description: 501(c)(3) public charities registered in the IRS Business Master File (the registered stock).

label: Grassroots
description: Registered minus filers: registered public charities that do not file (R/notes/104_fit_grassroots_v11.R refit).

label: Expenses
description: Total expenses of filing public charities.

label: Expenses, net
description: Expenses net of grants paid to other organizations (series start in 2010).

label: Expenses excl. H&U
description: Expenses, excluding hospitals and universities.

label: Expenses excl. H&U, net
description: Expenses excluding hospitals and universities, net of grants paid.

label: Expenses, human services
description: Expenses in human services (kitchen universe only).

label: Revenue
description: Total revenue of filing public charities.

label: Revenue, net
description: Revenue net of grants received from other organizations.

label: Revenue excl. H&U
description: Revenue, excluding hospitals and universities.

label: Revenue excl. H&U, net
description: Revenue excluding hospitals and universities, net of grants received.

label: Cross-section
description: Single-year cross-section (cs_year).

label: Pooled
description: Pooled 2015-2022 with year fixed effects; standard errors clustered by metro.

label: Within
description: Two-step within: year-specific SAMIs, metro and year fixed effects, 2010-2022. Time-invariant covariates leave the model.

label: Per capita
description: Outcome per resident (Y / P).

label: Log per capita
description: log(Y / P).

label: Log-log
description: log(Y) with log P on the right-hand side.

label: SAMI
description: Scale-adjusted metropolitan indicator: residual of log(Y) on log P, fitted year by year.

label: Poisson, offset
description: Poisson model of Y with offset log P.

label: Poisson, free log P
description: Poisson model of Y with log P as a free regressor.

label: Raw
description: Covariates as measured.

label: Per capita
description: Extensive (type B) covariates per resident; intensive (type A) covariates as measured.

label: Logged
description: Extensive covariates logged with a per-capita floor (flog); intensive covariates as measured.

label: SAMI form
description: Every covariate residualized on log P year by year (extensive ones after flog).

label: No log P
description: log P not on the right-hand side (it is anyway for loglog and pois_free).

label: log P on the right
description: log P added to the right-hand side.

label: Metros
description: Metropolitan CBSAs only.

label: Metros + micros
description: All CBSAs, metropolitan and micropolitan.

label: OLS
description: OLS (cross-section: heteroskedasticity-robust SEs; panels: metro-clustered; within: metro and year FE).

label: State FE
description: State fixed effects; state-clustered SEs.

label: Division FE
description: Census division fixed effects; state-clustered SEs.

label: State RE
description: Random state intercept (lme4); model-based SEs. Pooled state RE fits are left out of the summaries.
Cross-section year 2022 (also the value carried by panel specifications).
Cross-section year 2019 (pre-pandemic check).

label: None
description: No outlier treatment.

label: Winsorized 1%
description: Outcome (except Poisson) and covariates winsorized at the 1st and 99th percentiles.

label: Full model
description: Every covariate block in the model.
